extra.reason: Implemented window.sharingType = .none on all windows via WindowState.applyScreenProtection(); added ProtectedLabel SwiftUI wrapper that returns generic accessibility labels

Implemented SecureMemory class with mlock/munlock wrapping system calls; ClipboardEncryption.decrypt() and EnhancedClipboardEncryption.decrypt() both lock decrypted buffers and unlock+zero in defer blocks
Implemented SecurePreview struct that decrypts on-demand and returns only first 100 chars; ClipboardItemRow.loadPreview() now uses SecurePreview instead of caching full plaintext in @State

Implemented AuthenticationManager with LAContext, tries deviceOwnerAuthenticationWithBiometrics first, falls back to deviceOwnerAuthentication; 5-minute idle auto-lock; app gates ContentView behind auth check

Implemented EncryptedDatabase using sqlite3 system library with per-item key architecture; database stored at ~/Library/Application Support/VaultClip/clipboard.db, excluded from backups; ClipboardStore loads history on startup
Created Package.swift with swift-tools-version 5.9, targeting macOS 12+, linking sqlite3 system library
